responses.reason: The public spec defines active-high synchronous reset and 1-to-0 capture but does not specify whether input history from a reset cycle is used to detect a transition on the first released cycle. The current contract chooses that behavior without marking the reset-boundary ambiguity.
responses.spec_quote: changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next

value.note: Reset-boundary previous-input history is unspecified: it is ambiguous whether the first reset==0 posedge may capture a 1-to-0 transition based on the input sampled on the immediately preceding reset==1 posedge.
candidates: prev_in updates on reset cycles, so the first reset==0 posedge can capture a 1-to-0 transition from the reset-cycle input
prev_in is cleared or ignored during reset, so the first reset==0 posedge cannot capture a transition from the reset cycle and out remains 0
